failure_structure.interpretation: The dense predictor captures a real high-exposure conditional advantage but applies harmful changes to most low-exposure groups. Aggregate and tail gains therefore do not establish a reliable all-input router.

forbidden_followup: present aggregate error gain as stable routing
reuse the consumed validation scene as independent confirmation
interpret source statistics as physical exposure or illuminant truth
claim a film mode, calibrated stock response, scanner independence or product promotion
next_direction: test only a preregistered hard selective fallback that can abstain to the global operator, or move to independent content-diverse paired evidence; do not deploy the dense predictor
claim_ceiling: negative dense-routing and positive evaluator-Oracle evidence inside one author-prepared paired code-domain session; no physical exposure inference, film mode, calibrated stock response, scanner independence or product promotion
